architectureSummary: The dashboard uses Mantine's AppShell component as the foundation with a fixed header and collapsible sidebar. Main content area contains a responsive grid for stats cards, followed by chart sections and activity table. All data is centralized in mock data files. Components are organized by function: layout components for header/sidebar, common components for reusable elements, and feature components for dashboard-specific sections.

files.responsibility: Define Mantine theme overrides including color palette, typography scales, spacing rhythm, border radii, shadows, and component defaults that support the professional data-first design direction
Export array of stat metric objects containing title, value, change percentage, trend direction, and icon name for the stats cards grid
Export mock data arrays for line chart (revenue trends), bar chart (user activity), and pie chart (distribution data) with labels and values
Export array of 10 activity record objects with id, user name, action description, timestamp, and status for the activity table
Export array of navigation item objects with label, icon name, and route for sidebar navigation
Render fixed header with app branding, notification icon, user avatar with dropdown menu, and dark mode toggle switch. Manages theme switching via Mantine's ColorSchemeProvider.
Render collapsible sidebar navigation with navigation links, section groupings, and collapse toggle. On mobile, renders as hidden drawer triggered by header hamburger menu.
Render individual metric card displaying a key statistic with icon, value, title, and trend indicator. Used in the stats overview grid.
Render chart visualization wrapper using Recharts with mock data. Supports line, bar, and pie chart types with consistent styling.
Render consistent section heading with title and optional description. Used to label stats overview, charts section, and activity table.
Render responsive grid of StatsCard components displaying key performance metrics from mock data. Shows loading skeletons initially.
Render two-column grid of MockChart components showing revenue trends, user activity, and distribution data. Uses mock chart data.
Render paginated table of recent activity records with user avatar/name, action description, timestamp, and status badge. Uses mock activity data.

Compose the complete dashboard layout using Mantine AppShell with DashboardHeader, SidebarNav, and main content sections (StatsOverview, ChartsSection, ActivityTable). Initialize Mantine providers and theme.
